purpose: Publication privacy: remove container hostname and absolute session-local paths from four archived runner receipts.
method: UTF-8 literal substitutions only, applied in the rule order shown below. All other bytes are preserved, including numeric values and line endings. Original values are intentionally not published.

placeholders.$WORKSPACE: The absolute session workspace root; choose the local workspace root when reproducing.
placeholders.$REPO: The absolute measurement checkout directory under the workspace; choose the relevant checkout when reproducing.
placeholders.$TARGET_DIR: The absolute existing warmed Cargo target directory under the workspace; choose the reserved warmed target when reproducing.
placeholders.[redacted-hostname]: The container hostname from the uname receipt; not required for reproduction.

original_retention: Unredacted originals are retained in the task-local audit directory outside the publication checkout; original hashes below identify them without disclosing their paths or hostname.
unchanged_evidence: CPU rows and arrays, timing values, timer diagnostics, source, dependency manifest, lockfile, executable hash, checksums, byte controls, exit statuses and build/toolchain values were not changed. No measurement or build was rerun.
